# PerformanceOS

> AI diet coach and photo food logging app designed for Indian meals, strength training, focus tracking, and daily budgeting.

## Overview
PerformanceOS allows users to snap a photo of any meal (with deep support for Indian foods such as rotis, katoris, biryani, thalis), decomposes items with estimated portion sizes, and provides adaptive calorie targets calculated from 30-day weight trend analysis.

## Brand Baselines
- Daily estimated burn: 2,550 kcal
- Daily target: 2,000 kcal
- Calorie deficit: 550 kcal / day
- Rate of progress: -0.5 kg / week fat loss
- Protein target: 180 g / day

## Standard Indian Portions (IFCT 2017 Baselines)
- Standard katori: 150 ml (or 150 g)
- Medium phulka: 35 g each (2 phulkas = 70 g)
- Standard thali: 26 cm
- Tablespoon: 15 ml
- Teaspoon cooking oil: 5 g (45 kcal)

## Verified Indian Foods Database (Calculated from IFCT 2017)
All cooked values are calculated from raw ingredient composition tables:

### Paneer Bhurji (/calories/paneer-bhurji)
- Category: curry
- Standard portion: 1 standard katori (150 g) -> 240 kcal, 18.5g protein, 6.5g carbs, 15g fat
- Base (100g): 160 kcal, 12g protein, 4.5g carbs, 10g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~180g
- Lighter tip: Use low-fat paneer (skim milk chhena) and reduce oil to 1 teaspoon (5 g) per 2 servings to save up to 100 kcal.

### Chicken Dum Biryani (/calories/chicken-biryani)
- Category: rice
- Standard portion: 1 generous home plate (320 g) -> 480 kcal, 32g protein, 62g carbs, 14g fat
- Base (100g): 150 kcal, 10g protein, 19.5g carbs, 4.5g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~320g
- Lighter tip: Opt for chicken breast over dark meat cuts and accompany with fresh cucumber mint raita made with low-fat curd.

### Dal Tadka (/calories/dal-tadka)
- Category: curry
- Standard portion: 1 standard katori (150 g) -> 140 kcal, 7g protein, 19.5g carbs, 4g fat
- Base (100g): 95 kcal, 4.5g protein, 13g carbs, 2.5g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~300g
- Lighter tip: Measure tempering ghee with a teaspoon (5 g = 45 kcal) rather than pouring directly from the jar.

### Masala Dosa (/calories/masala-dosa)
- Category: breakfast
- Standard portion: 1 standard restaurant dosa (180 g) -> 330 kcal, 8g protein, 55g carbs, 8.5g fat
- Base (100g): 185 kcal, 4.5g protein, 30.5g carbs, 4.5g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~180g
- Lighter tip: Order plain roast or request minimal oil on the tawa; dip chutney sparingly rather than pouring it over the plate.

### Kanda Poha (/calories/poha)
- Category: breakfast
- Standard portion: 1 standard breakfast bowl (150 g) -> 285 kcal, 6g protein, 43g carbs, 10.5g fat
- Base (100g): 190 kcal, 4g protein, 28.5g carbs, 7g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~150g
- Lighter tip: Toast peanuts dry in a separate pan to lower cooking oil requirement without losing characteristic crunch.

### Phulka Roti (/calories/roti)
- Category: staple
- Standard portion: 2 medium phulkas (70 g) -> 180 kcal, 6g protein, 34g carbs, 1g fat
- Base (100g): 255 kcal, 8.5g protein, 48.5g carbs, 1.5g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~70g
- Lighter tip: Skip brushing ghee on the cooked phulka to save ~40-45 kcal per bread while keeping standard whole-wheat fiber.

### Steamed Idli (/calories/idli)
- Category: breakfast
- Standard portion: 2 idlis serving (90 g) -> 180 kcal, 5.5g protein, 38.5g carbs, 0.5g fat
- Base (100g): 200 kcal, 6g protein, 43g carbs, 0.5g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~90g
- Lighter tip: Pair with light vegetable sambar rather than rich coconut chutney to keep total meal fat low.

### Boiled Eggs (/calories/boiled-eggs)
- Category: protein
- Standard portion: 2 boiled eggs (100 g) -> 150 kcal, 13g protein, 1g carbs, 10g fat
- Base (100g): 150 kcal, 13g protein, 1g carbs, 10g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~100g
- Lighter tip: Discard one yolk out of two to drop ~55 kcal and ~4.5 g fat while retaining pure egg-white albumen protein.

### Oats with Banana & Milk (/calories/oats-banana)
- Category: breakfast
- Standard portion: 1 large morning bowl (350 g) -> 380 kcal, 15.5g protein, 61.5g carbs, 9g fat
- Base (100g): 110 kcal, 4.5g protein, 17.5g carbs, 2.5g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~250g
- Lighter tip: Cook oats primarily in water with a splash of milk and rely on cinnamon powder for natural aroma without table sugar.

### Curd Rice (/calories/curd-rice)
- Category: rice
- Standard portion: 1 full dinner bowl (250 g) -> 350 kcal, 9g protein, 58.5g carbs, 8.5g fat
- Base (100g): 140 kcal, 3.5g protein, 23.5g carbs, 3.5g fat
- Cooked recipe yield: ~150g
- Lighter tip: Use homemade toned dahi and add diced cucumber to increase volume with negligible additional calories.

## Key Features
- Photo Food Logging: Computer vision detects meal components, portions, and hidden cooking oils.
- Adaptive Daily Targets: Exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) trend weight computes true daily expenditure, adjusting weekly.
- Personal AI Coach: In-depth context from the user's past 14 days of nutrition, sleep, focus, and strength training.
- Daily Operating System: Combines Strength Log (sets, reps, progressive overload), Focus Timer (deep work tracking), Daily Budget (remaining allowance), and Daily Big Three Priorities.
- Private & Offline First: Works seamlessly offline; zero ads, no third-party tracking, full data export available.
